lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A rectilinear grid of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in roughly 12 visible vertical columns, with centroids maintaining consistent inter-blob distance in the mid-lateral zone.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of higher luminance intersect with horizontal carinae; blobs are anchored at these intersections forming a lattice-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal ridges extending along the upper two-thirds of the flank, characterized by high-luminance peak intensity and sharp vertical shadow gradients immediately ventral to the peaks.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 12-16 high-luminance blobs distributed across the surface of the first dorsal fin, with higher spatial density in the basal and posterior regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, elongated, high-luminance linear structure (external tag) is visible on the upper flank, anterior to the first dorsal fin base.
other_distinctive_markers: A remora is visible as a low-luminance silhouette attached to the ventral region; the caudal fin displays high-contrast spotting on the upper lobe.
